did.unittitle: Artists Pamphlet collection

corpname.part: Robert B. Haas Family Arts Library Special Collections

descriptivenote.p: Chiefly in English with some materials in European and non-European languages.

did.abstract: The collection contains pamphlets, brochures, and other ephemera on individual artists published by museums, galleries, and other institutions throughout the world.

acqinfo.head: Immediate Source of Acquisition
acqinfo.p: Assembled over time by the Yale University Art and Architecture Library.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: The materials are open for research.

userestrict.head: Conditions Governing Use
userestrict.p: Copyright has not been transferred to Yale University.

prefercite.head: Preferred Citation
prefercite.p: Artists Pamphlet Collection, Robert B. Haas Family Arts Library, Yale University.

bioghist.head: Biographical / Historical
bioghist.p: The Artists Pamphlet Collection was assembled over time by the Yale University Art and Architecture Library as a means of facilitating access to and use of printed ephemeral material about individual artists.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: The collection contains pamphlets, brochures, and other ephemera on individual artists published by museums, galleries, and other institutions throughout the world. The majority of the materials are exhibition listings and catalogs.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Individual bibliographic records were created in the Yale library catalog previously for the majority of the items in the collection and assigned the location Art and Architecture, Uncataloged A, and the call number xcat A[rtists]. These material are not shelved individually but are boxed in alphabetical order by artist name. Readers who have identified an item in the library catalog that they wish to see should consult the box listing within the collection finding aid to determine which box should be requested through the Arts Library Special Collections department.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: Materials are arranged roughly alphabetically by artists' name.

custodhist.head: Custodial History
custodhist.p: This collection was originally stewarded by the Robert B. Haas Family Arts Library at Yale Library. In July 2026, the collection's stewardship was transferred to Beinecke Rare Book and Manuscript Library.
